body: In `JsonLinesSink::emit_tick` and `StderrSink::emit_tick` (tracing.rs:124-128, 135-139), both serialization errors (`serde_json::to_string`) and write errors (`writeln!`) are silently swallowed. For CI archival use — one of the three stated output modes — silently losing trace records makes it impossible to detect data loss. At minimum, consider logging or counting dropped records. For `JsonLinesSink` specifically, the `let _ = writeln!` could be changed to propagate or record the error, since file I/O failures during CI runs are not uncommon (disk full, broken pipe). Alternatively, change `TraceSink::emit_tick` to return a `Result` so callers can decide the policy.
